bio: Research Overview Contact Us Laura Berbert is a biostatistician in the Biostatistics and Research Design Center of the Institutional Centers for Clinical and Translational Research (ICCTR) . She provides statistical support for the design and analysis of observational and clinical studies. Laura joined Boston Children’s Hospital in 2019 as a biostatistician in the Biostatistics and Research Design Center of the Institutional Centers for Clinical and Translational Research. She earned a master’s degree in biostatistics from the University of Pittsburgh in 2014.
